title: A Survey On the Oscillation Bounds 1 and 1/e for First Order Delay Differential Equations
content: Consider the first-order linear differential equation with a delay argument of the form x′(t) + p(t)x(τ(t)) = 0, t ≥ t₀, where the functions p, τ ∈ C([t₀, ∞), R⁺), (here R⁺ = [0, ∞)), τ(t) ≤ t for t ≥ t₀ and limt→∞τ(t) = ∞. Conditions involving the oscillation bounds 1 and 1/e under which all solutions to this equation oscillate are presented in chronological order. Oscillation conditions are also presented in the critical case. Examples illustrating the results are given.
